title: P5-11: Cutover: move p.apyr.us, apex redirect, SES and Slack, with rollback
description:
## Goal
Hard cutover: `p.apyr.us` (and the apex redirect, staging host) are served by the new app; inbound email, Slack and the other kept features run on the new backend; rollback proven.

## Context (FACT)
- Domain association `apyr.us` lives on the old app (subdomains `p` -> main and the apex -> main, apex unverified); a domain belongs to one app, so it is deleted from the old app first, then added by the new stack (brief downtime accepted: pre-production, Git history is the rollback, Ryan 2026-10-07).
- Zone Z10285921B1G7MVRV06W9 has `p.apyr.us` A alias plus MX `10 inbound-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com`; the old backend creates the MX and the active SES rule set `papyrus-inbound-p-apyr-us` (only one active rule set per region). Apex rule `https://apyr.us` -> `https://p.apyr.us` is an app-level 302 today; `papyrus.anth.us` returns 200 from a different host and is in the epic's earlier scope (redirect to p.apyr.us; not investigated here, Q8).
- Slack: events URL points at the old backend (secret names PAPYRUS_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, PAPYRUS_SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET).
- Rollback = old app and backend are still intact (deleted only in P5-12): re-point the domain back.

## Exact steps (a runbook Ryan or an agent with his yes runs; each step has a stop point)
1. Pre-flight: P5-07..P5-10 done, delta data copy of P5-09 (editing freeze), `curl` baseline of old `/newsroom` and `/` saved.
2. Ryan yes. Old app: `aws amplify delete-domain-association --app-id dbsyytcm9drqa --domain-name apyr.us`; record the previous association JSON for rollback.
3. New stack: set `cms.domainName` `p.apyr.us`, `stagingDomainName`, `redirects` apex (P5-03), flags (P5-04) on; deploy; wait for the ACM certificate; check Route 53 keeps the MX record (or the new backend recreates it).
4. SES handoff in order: deactivate old rule set (`aws ses set-active-receipt-rule-set` with no name by Ryan), new stack activates `papyrus-inbound-p-apyr-us`-equivalent; send a test mail to submissions@p.apyr.us.
5. Slack: Ryan updates the events request URL in the Slack app; run the e2e check.
6. Smoke checks (below). Post-cutover update of `redirectUrls` already includes `https://p.apyr.us/newsroom`.
7. Announce; keep the old app untouched for 7 days (P5-12).

## Acceptance checks
- `curl -sI https://p.apyr.us/` 200 marketing; `/information` 200 (empty edition placeholder or published items); `/newsroom` 200 and Google sign-in completes; `/2026/october/07` 301 to `/information/2026/october/07`; `/information` 404 is gone; `https://apyr.us/x` redirects to `https://p.apyr.us/x` with status 301.
- Test email to the submissions address arrives as a Reference in the NEW backend; no mail in the old.
- `/robots.txt` allows on production, staging disallows.
- Cognito callback and sign-in on the production domain succeed.

## Rollback (rehearsed on paper, executed only if the checks fail within the window)
Delete the new domain association, re-create `apyr.us` on the old app with `p` and apex subdomains from the recorded JSON, re-activate the old SES rule set, restore the Slack URL. The old backend never stopped existing. Git history of AnthusAI/Papyrus main still builds the old site.

## Risks
Certificate wait; Amplify rewrites DNS for the apex and `p`; MX deletion by old stack if it deploys during the window (pause old main builds first: disable auto-build on old `main`); CloudFront cache of old content.

## Needs Ryan
Yes to every domain, SES and Slack step; go/no-go at step 6.

P5-10/P5-11 CROSS-ACCOUNT CUTOVER PLAN (2026-10-10, READ-ONLY research; nothing executed, no AWS/Git writes). Accounts asserted before every call: legacy 335163751677 (zone), papyrus-production 712236451410 (new app ds6yswxui41yi, 0 domain associations, branch main only, WEB_COMPUTE). Raw zone snapshot saved: scratchpad/zone-before.json. ## 1. Route 53 inventory, zone Z10285921B1G7MVRV06W9 (apyr.us, 6 records) | name | type | TTL | value | owner / touch? | | apyr.us | A ALIAS | alias(60s eff.) | d13az1w6nbqel5.cloudfront.net (Z2FDTNDATAQYW2) | old assoc apex; SWITCH in Phase C2 | | p.apyr.us | A ALIAS | alias | same d13az1w6nbqel5.cloudfront.net | old assoc prefix p; SWITCH in Phase C1 | | p.apyr.us | MX | 300 | 10 inbound-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com | SES inbound: NEVER TOUCH | | _120b425c2695370e9f2b6eb66af6d53e.apyr.us | CNAME | 500 | _851309890674eab28658c94409e43eae.jkddzztszm.acm-validations.aws | OLD assoc cert validation: keep until old assoc deleted (renewal of old cert) | | apyr.us | NS 172800 / SOA 900 | | | never | No CAA, no TXT/SPF/DKIM, no www, no p-staging. Registrar NS = the 4 zone NS (matches). Live: apyr.us/x -> 302 https://p.apyr.us/x (app rule); p.apyr.us/ 200. papyrus.anth.us is in the anth.us zone Z02552332GG6AM25SFP73 (also legacy, ACM cert fad13f85 exists): OUT of this plan, handled by Q8 separately; nothing here touches it. Old app dbsyytcm9drqa association apyr.us AVAILABLE, autoSub false, subdomains: p->main (verified) and ''->main (verified False, yet the apex alias works). Branches main + codex-rehydration-api-split both enableAutoBuild true. Custom rules: apyr.us -> https://p.apyr.us 302, then 404-200. No other app holds apyr.us. Legacy SES active rule set papyrus-inbound-p-apyr-us. ## 2. MX / CNAME conflict and chosen pattern Amplify, when the zone is not in its account, only DISPLAYS records (get-domain-association: certificateVerificationDNSRecord and subDomains[].dnsRecord as " CNAME dXXXX.cloudfront.net"). A literal CNAME at p.apyr.us is illegal beside the MX. Today p is already an A ALIAS to CloudFront (what Amplify itself writes in-account). Route 53 alias-to-CloudFront needs only the distribution domain + fixed zone Z2FDTNDATAQYW2 and does not require the distribution to be in the same account (the Amplify-managed distribution is in an AWS-service account anyway). CHOSEN PATTERN: - p.apyr.us: UPSERT A ALIAS -> .cloudfront.net, HostedZoneId Z2FDTNDATAQYW2, EvaluateTargetHealth false. MX untouched (an UPSERT of the A set never affects the MX set). - apyr.us (apex): UPSERT A ALIAS -> (same pattern, as today). - p-staging.apyr.us: plain CNAME -> .cloudfront.net, TTL 300 (no MX at that name). - ACM validation: the new association has its OWN token (per account+domain), a second CNAME `_.apyr.us -> _..acm-validations.aws.`; it coexists with the old `_120b...` one (different names). Do not remove it afterwards: Amplify cannot renew the certificate if the record is deleted (AWS docs). - Optional: AAAA alias not added (old had none). Distribution domains differ per subdomain: read each from get-domain-association (they are not necessarily one shared distribution). ## 3. Cross-account association behaviour (AWS docs "third-party DNS" flow + zone evidence) - AWS::Amplify::Domain deploys with only the domain name; it writes NO DNS here. Status goes PENDING_VERIFICATION (then PENDING_DEPLOYMENT) until the ACM validation CNAME exists, then AVAILABLE. ACM polls aggressively at first and backs off: add the validation CNAME within minutes of the stack update (hours later can strand the association). - Docs: with production traffic, point the subdomain record at the new target only AFTER the domain shows AVAILABLE. So: create association, add validation CNAME, wait AVAILABLE, then one UPSERT = the cutover (old distribution keeps serving until that instant; ~60s alias TTL = near-zero downtime). - UNVERIFIED RISK R1: Amplify may refuse to create a second association for apyr.us/prefix p while the OLD association in another account holds it (same-account same-prefix does fail with BadRequestException, proven in the TI plan; cross-account unknown, CloudFront alternate-domain conflicts are possible). The CFN failure is harmless (stack UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE, Domain never created, legacy untouched). FALLBACK if refused: delete-domain-association on the old app (deletes only its own p and apex ALIAS records, not MX, not `_120b`), then re-run the deploy; downtime = deploy + cert validation, est. 5-15 min. Rollback of fallback = create-domain-association on the old app (recreates the ALIAS records). - Verification of the apex subdomain: old apex was "verified False" yet served; do not block on it. ## 4. Template and site.json (origin/develop 5883479, scaffold AnthusAI/p.apyr.us main d624ec5, papyrus 1.0.0-next.37) - Scaffold infra/site.json is ALREADY the full config (hostedZoneId Z10285921B1G7MVRV06W9, domainName apyr.us, domainPrefix p, stagingDomainPrefix p-staging, redirects [{apyr.us,301}], PAPYRUS_ENABLE_INBOUND_EMAIL "true", BACKUPS true). Matches examples/p-apyr-us.site.json except version/email/redirect URLs. Template never writes Route 53 (hostedZoneId is accepted config; Papyrus#143 test asserts none; shared-root-domain.feature). - Template emits: App customRules [https://apyr.us -> https://p.apyr.us 301, 404-200]; ONE AWS::Amplify::Domain (apyr.us; SubDomainSettings main->p, main->'' apex, staging->p-staging; DependsOn production + staging branch; no EnableAutoSubDomain); CfnBranch StagingBranch (BETA, SITE_ENV staging, PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE drafts, NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_STAGING_URL https://p-staging.apyr.us, staging build spec); output StagingOrigin. - Deployed domain-free copy (site.p507.json, next.31, staging false, INBOUND_EMAIL false) vs scaffold: ADD hostedZoneId, domainName/prefixes/redirects; REMOVE staging:false; version next.31 -> next.37 (build specs/env); INBOUND_EMAIL false -> true (!); OAUTH list: deployed branch value = 8 literal entries + the appended default `https://main.ds6yswxui41yi.amplifyapp.com/` (9 total, SUPERSET). With domainName set the template no longer appends defaults, but the scaffold literal list already contains main.ds6yswxui41yi.amplifyapp.com both with and without /newsroom, localhost x2, p.apyr.us x2, p-staging x2: every sign-in address is retained (no regression). Verify post-diff by list equality. - DECISION NEEDED (D1): INBOUND_EMAIL true in the scaffold activates the new backend's inbound email (new SES resources in the production account; p.apyr.us MX already points to the regional endpoint but the legacy account's active rule set still receives the mail, and receipt for a domain in another account needs that domain verified in SES there, i.e. a possible `_amazonses` TXT = another legacy zone write). Recommend: deploy Phase B with INBOUND_EMAIL "false" (edit one line in a PR) and do the SES handoff as its own step after DNS is stable. This keeps the DNS cutover independent of mail. - Staging code facts: lib/staging-gated-path.ts gates only the readerBasePath (/information and below) when readerBasePath is set; `/` marketing, /newsroom, /api, static, /robots.txt are never gated; scaffold papyrus.config.ts sets readerBasePath "/information", stagingBuild enabled. Pretext drafts-mode build fix is in next.31+ (#165). Git `staging` branch on AnthusAI/p.apyr.us does NOT exist (heads: main, scaffold/initial, 3 feature/fix). ## 5. PLAN (every WRITE needs Ryan's yes in chat; none run) PRE-FLIGHT (read-only) export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1; B=~/Projects/.baselines/p-apyr-us-cutover-$(date +%Y%m%d); mkdir -p $B AWS_PROFILE=legacy aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text # 335163751677 AWS_PROFILE=legacy aws route53 list-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z10285921B1G7MVRV06W9 > $B/zone-before.json AWS_PROFILE=legacy aws amplify list-domain-associations --app-id dbsyytcm9drqa > $B/old-assoc.json ; ...get-domain-association --app-id dbsyytcm9drqa --domain-name apyr.us > $B/old-assoc-full.json; ...get-app --app-id dbsyytcm9drqa > $B/old-app.json AWS_PROFILE=papyrus-production aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text # 712236451410 AWS_PROFILE=papyrus-production aws amplify get-app --app-id ds6yswxui41yi > $B/new-app.json; ...list-branches...; ...get-branch --branch-name main (names + OAUTH list) ; aws cloudformation get-template --stack-name amplify-app-shell-p-apyr-us-cms > $B/stack-template-before.json Live baseline: for u in / /newsroom /information /archive /robots.txt; do curl -s -o $B/old$(echo $u|tr / _).html -D $B/old$(echo $u|tr / _).hdr https://p.apyr.us$u; shasum -a 256 $B/old*.html; done; curl -sI https://apyr.us/x (302 -> p) ; echo | openssl s_client -connect p.apyr.us:443 -servername p.apyr.us 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -issuer -serial -enddate -ext subjectAltName ; dig +short MX p.apyr.us ; dig +short A p.apyr.us apyr.us Old app: freeze builds: aws amplify update-branch --app-id dbsyytcm9drqa --branch-name main --no-enable-auto-build (and codex-rehydration-api-split) [legacy WRITE, Ryan yes; a stray old build/stack deploy could touch MX]. TTL: alias records have no settable TTL (Route 53 alias = 60s); MX 300 and `_120b` 500 are untouched; nothing to lower. The new p-staging CNAME and validation CNAME get TTL 300. PHASE A (zero risk) A1 [Ryan yes; git push of a NEW ref only] git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/AnthusAI/p.apyr.us ~/Projects/p.apyr.us-cut; cd it; git push origin main:refs/heads/staging ; git ls-remote --heads origin staging A2 (D1) PR on p.apyr.us setting PAPYRUS_ENABLE_INBOUND_EMAIL "false" (recommended) and merge. Confirm infra/site.json papyrusVersion next.37 is published on npm. A3 cd infra && npx papyrus-infra synth && AWS_PROFILE=papyrus-production npx aws-cdk@2 diff --app cdk.out AmplifyAppShell-p-apyr-us (read-only). EXPECT: ADD Branch StagingBranch; ADD Domain (3 subdomain settings, appId ds6yswxui41yi); MODIFY App (customRules adds apyr.us->p.apyr.us 301; buildSpec for next.37); MODIFY Branch main (env: OAUTH list literal, version-driven); ADD output StagingOrigin; possibly GithubCiRole trust gains refs/heads/staging (TI saw this: Ryan to accept). NOTHING replaced or deleted; no Route53, no legacy-account ARNs, no SES/MX, no Cognito pool replacement. Any replacement of App/UserPool/Bucket = STOP. PHASE B (stack update; production-account WRITE; legacy only the CNAME) B1 [Ryan yes] AWS_PROFILE=papyrus-production npx aws-cdk@2 deploy AmplifyAppShell-p-apyr-us --app cdk.out --require-approval broadening . If BadRequest "domain already associated" (R1): rollback is automatic, go to FALLBACK F below. B2 Read values (production profile): aws amplify get-domain-association --app-id ds6yswxui41yi --domain-name apyr.us --query 'domainAssociation.[domainStatus,certificateVerificationDNSRecord,subDomains[].[subDomainSetting.prefix,subDomainSetting.branchName,dnsRecord,verified]]' --output json > $B/new-assoc.json B3 [Ryan yes, ONE legacy write, immediately after B2] create the validation CNAME only. Change batch $B/add-validation.json: {"Comment":"P5-11 Amplify cert validation for new app ds6yswxui41yi","Changes":[{"Action":"CREATE","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"_.apyr.us.","Type":"CNAME","TTL":300,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"_..acm-validations.aws."}]}}]} AWS_PROFILE=legacy aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z10285921B1G7MVRV06W9 --change-batch file://$B/add-validation.json ROLLBACK B3: same batch with "Action":"DELETE" (exact same values). B4 [Ryan yes, second legacy write, no live impact] create p-staging: CREATE CNAME p-staging.apyr.us. TTL 300 -> .cloudfront.net (value from B2). Rollback: DELETE with same values. B5 Wait: loop aws amplify get-domain-association ... until domainStatus AVAILABLE (expect minutes); then check the new distributions answer for the host before DNS: curl -sI --resolve p.apyr.us:443:$(dig +short

| head -1) https://p.apyr.us/ ; same for apyr.us (expect 200 / 301) and staging. B6 Staging build: aws amplify start-job --app-id ds6yswxui41yi --branch-name staging --job-type RELEASE (production profile); poll get-job. Branch is stack-created so the console-connect buildSpec overwrite does not apply, but if the build spec/env is stripped re-apply by a stack update with PAPYRUS_STACK_REAPPLY=1 then without (as TI). B7 Staging checklist on https://p-staging.apyr.us (works before the live switch): anonymous GET / is 200 marketing (public); anonymous /information -> exactly one redirect to /newsroom, no loop, X-Robots-Tag noindex,nofollow, /robots.txt disallow all; /newsroom 200; editor session sees the draft under /information/YYYY//DD/ and Preview; non-editor 403; draft absent from production; main branch has no SITE_ENV / PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW / drafts var (names only). Also: node scripts/check-staging-guards.mjs https://p-staging.apyr.us staging (Papyrus repo). Production: also run curl against the new distribution (B5 --resolve) for / , /information (200), /newsroom, legacy redirects (/2026/october/07 -> 301 /information/2026/october/07, /articles/x, /archive, /settings), sign-in round trip using the amplifyapp.com origin, media/video range request if any. PHASE C (the switch, GO/NO-GO by Ryan after B5/B7) C1 [Ryan yes] UPSERT p only, batch $B/switch-p.json: {"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"p.apyr.us.","Type":"A","AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"Z2FDTNDATAQYW2","DNSName":".cloudfront.net.","EvaluateTargetHealth":false}}}]} (pre-save $B/restore-p.json = same with DNSName d13az1w6nbqel5.cloudfront.net.) Verify MX still present: dig +short MX p.apyr.us; zone diff vs zone-before.json shows only the p A change. Watch: until dig +short A p.apyr.us returns new CloudFront IPs and curl -sI https://p.apyr.us/ shows the new app (x-amz-cf-id different CloudFront, content from new app, cert issuer Amazon and a new serial); expect 1-3 min. C2 Full checklist on https://p.apyr.us: / 200 marketing; /information 200; legacy redirects 301; /newsroom 200 + Google sign-in returns to /newsroom; /robots.txt allows; no noindex header; Cognito callbacks list (names/URL list equality with saved); 24-route screenshot style check if wanted. C3 [Ryan yes] apex: UPSERT apyr.us A ALIAS -> (same shape; $B/restore-apex.json = old target). Verify curl -sI https://apyr.us/x -> 301 https://p.apyr.us/x (was 302). PHASE D (old app; only after Ryan sign-off, keep 7 days) D1 old auto-build OFF (done in pre-flight). Old association stays: it is harmless while the records point elsewhere; do NOT run update/delete on it earlier. D2 [Ryan yes, after 7 days / P5-12] aws amplify delete-domain-association --app-id dbsyytcm9drqa --domain-name apyr.us . DANGER: Amplify deletes its own subdomain records by name (p and apyr.us ALIAS), which would delete the NEW alias records now pointing at the new app. FIRST check zone after deletion; if p / apex are gone, immediately re-UPSERT from $B/switch-p.json and $B/switch-apex.json. Safer: delete the association, then re-run the saved UPSERTs in the same minute (Ryan present), or leave the old association in place until the old app itself is deleted in P5-12 (preferred: delete the whole app and re-check the zone). Then remove the `_120b...` CNAME ONLY after the old association is gone. Keep MX and the new validation CNAME forever. ROLLBACK - After B (any failure): stack rollback is automatic; if Domain exists, remove it via PR reverting domain fields + cdk deploy (or delete-domain-association --app-id ds6yswxui41yi, production profile); delete the added CNAMEs with the DELETE batches. Live site unaffected (old records untouched). - After C1/C3: aws route53 change-resource-record-sets ... file://$B/restore-p.json and restore-apex.json (UPSERT back to d13az1w6nbqel5). Old app and association are intact (auto-build off), so the old site returns within ~60s. Verify with the saved pre-flight hashes/headers; MX unchanged throughout. - FALLBACK F (R1) rollback: aws amplify create-domain-association --app-id dbsyytcm9drqa --domain-name apyr.us --no-enable-auto-sub-domain --sub-domain-settings prefix=p,branchName=main prefix=,branchName=main ; verify the alias records and 200. ## 6. Downtime, risk, go/no-go - Planned path: ~1-3 min (alias TTL 60s, Cloudfront switch); no outage window if B5 shows the new distributions answer first. Fallback F path: 5-15 min. - Risks: R1 cross-account refusal (handled by F); validation CNAME not added in time (stuck PENDING_VERIFICATION: add promptly; if stuck, delete and recreate the Domain); old association deletion later removes the NEW alias records (D2 warning); INBOUND_EMAIL decision D1 and SES/Slack handoffs (separate steps, not DNS); the apex subdomain "verified" flag may stay false (as today); stack-created branch env checks; GithubCiRole trust change in diff. - GO/NO-GO: GO for A, B (low risk: additive, one new CNAME each, production unaffected). C is GO if B5 curl via --resolve and B7 pass and MX dig unchanged; NO-GO on any replace/delete in the diff. ## 7. Approvals Ryan must give (each its own yes in chat) (1) push new Git ref staging; (2) merge PR for INBOUND_EMAIL decision; (3) old branches auto-build off (legacy write); (4) cdk deploy in papyrus-production; (5) legacy WRITE: validation CNAME (B3); (6) legacy WRITE: p-staging CNAME (B4); (7) staging start-job; (8) go/no-go + legacy WRITE C1 (p switch); (9) legacy WRITE C3 (apex); (10) D2 old association/CNAME deletion after sign-off. Ryan by hand: Google sign-ins as editor and non-editor, visual approval; nothing in consoles. SSO login for both profiles if expired.
